page_title: ROM 1-0 GEN | AS Roma v Genoa 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar makes a comfortable save.
90+4' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Paulo Dybala leaves the pitch to be replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
90+2' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) replaces Romelu Lukaku.
90+1' Substitution. David Ankeye (Genoa) has come on for Morten Frendrup.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
87' Koni De Winter (Genoa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
86' 20:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
82' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
81' It's time for a substitution. Vitinha (Genoa) comes on in place of Alessandro Vogliacco.
81' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) on for Milan Badelj.
81' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) replacing Angelino.
79' 1 - 0 Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
79' Angelino (AS Roma) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the top right corner, but Josep Martinez gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
77' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

77' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' Djed Spence (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is sent-off after receiving his second yellow card!
72' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
72' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Josep Martinez.
70' Angelino (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
70' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
69' Angelino (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
69' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Josep Martinez.
67' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Caleb Ekuban cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Substitution. Kevin Strootman leaves the pitch and is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
66' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
63' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Tommaso Baldanzi and he is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lorenzo Pellegrini walks off the pitch to be replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
63' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
62' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
62' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends it out of play.
61' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
59' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
57' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
57' A nice individual effort by Mateo Retegui (Genoa) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
55' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
54' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Josep Martinez is prepared and dives to thwart him.
54' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
52' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball misses the left post by a few inches.
51' The referee blows his whistle as Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) was too aggressive in his challenge. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
51' Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Evan Ndicka (AS Roma).
50' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez was alert and made a comfortable save.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
43' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
42' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
40' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is hurriedly cleared.
39' Aaron Martin (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
37' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
36' AS Roma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Angelino (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but Josep Martinez punches the ball away.
34' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
31' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the right post.
31' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
30' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
29' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
29' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Mile Svilar.
28' Dangerous play by Zeki Celik (AS Roma). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
25' 49:51 – the ratio of ball possession.
23' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
22' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

21' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Gianluca Manganiello no option but to blow his whistle. Genoa will take a free kick near the side line.
19' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for an infringement.

16' This was a nice set play that lacked a finish. Unmarked Angelino (AS Roma) controlled a precise lofted pass from the corner kick and unleashed a long-range shot. He hit the ball very poorly, sending it into the stands.
15' The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

15' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
14' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
13' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

12' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
8' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
7' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
3' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
